result.topic_en: Outline notes on the collision of two bodies, covering the motion of the centre of mass, elastic versus inelastic impact and rotation, and what follows for the forces involved.
result.transcription:

b, Bei andern verwandelt er sich in d. Gestalt [?] (elastisch)
